According to Adobe Inc.'s fiscal 2024 Form 10-K:

### 1. Total Digital Media Segment Revenue in Fiscal 2024
* **$15.86 billion** (reported as **$15,864 million**)

### 2. Year-over-Year Percentage Growth from Fiscal 2023
* Reported year-over-year growth: **12%**
* Fiscal 2023 Digital Media segment revenue was **$14.22 billion** (reported as **$14,216 million**).
* Calculation using exact millions: 
  $$\frac{15,864 - 14,216}{14,216} = \frac{1,648}{14,216} \approx 11.59\% \text{ (or 12\% rounded)}$$
* Calculation using billions:
  $$\frac{15.86 - 14.22}{14.22} = \frac{1.64}{14.22} \approx 11.53\% \text{ (or 12\% rounded)}$$

***
